dataset.name: HCRN GU16-260 nivolumab-treated advanced ccRCC cohort (2025)
dataset.description: Independent treatment-naive advanced clear-cell renal-cell carcinoma cohort with pretreatment bulk tumor RNA sequencing and individual progression-free and overall-survival follow-up during nivolumab monotherapy.
dataset.cohort_context: The phase II HCRN GU16-260 release contains 102 clinical records and 90 expression-linked tumors across clear-cell and non-clear-cell RCC. TRACE Explorer prespecifies the 72 clear-cell patients to match TCGA-KIRC and excludes 18 non-clear-cell tumors before endpoint analysis.

metadata.source_program: HCRN GU16-260 randomized phase II trial (NCT03117309), Part A
metadata.source_data_system: PMC author manuscript and public article supplements
metadata.library_method: FFPE tumor RNA captured with Illumina TruSeq RNA Exome, sequenced as 76-bp paired-end reads on HiSeq 2000 or 2500, aligned with STAR 2.7.10a and quantified with RSEM 1.3.1
metadata.treatment_context: Previously untreated advanced clear-cell renal-cell carcinoma treated with nivolumab monotherapy
metadata.endpoint_context: Trial-defined progression-free and overall survival after nivolumab initiation
metadata.sample_selection_note: Supplementary Table S1 contains 102 unique subjects and Supplementary Table S2 contains 90 unique expression columns, all linked exactly to clinical records. Eligibility is fixed before endpoint analysis to clear-cell histology, a present expression column, positive OS and PFS times and explicit censor indicators, retaining 72 unique patients. The authors selected a metastatic specimen when a patient had paired primary and metastatic samples.
metadata.expression_processing_note: The authors aligned RNA-seq reads with STAR and quantified expression with RSEM. Every source expression column sums to approximately 1,000,000, confirming the article-described TPM scale. TRACE Explorer preserves the supplied TPM values unchanged.
metadata.expression_curation_note: The source workbook contains 56,238 expression rows with Ensembl identifiers and supplied gene descriptions. Twenty-nine descriptions were converted by Excel into date values and cannot be recovered unambiguously. Among the remaining rows, case-insensitive duplicate screening identifies 203 ambiguous descriptions spanning 2,140 rows. Date-formatted and duplicated descriptions are excluded rather than guessed or aggregated, leaving 54,069 exact and case-insensitively unique gene labels.
metadata.endpoint_caveat: OS_CNSR and PFS_CNSR encode 1 as an observed event and 0 as censoring. The retained clear-cell cohort contains 26 OS events and 46 OS-censored observations, and 55 PFS events and 17 PFS-censored observations.
metadata.overlap_note: HCRN GU16-260 is independent of TCGA-KIRC and of the active RECA-EU, CPTAC, IMmotion150, FUSCC, Dana-Farber epigenomic-atlas, CheckMate and JAVELIN Renal 101 releases.
metadata.license_note: The author manuscript states that patient-level clinical data and normalized RNA-seq expression are included in public Supplementary Tables S1 and S2. The files are downloaded and transformed in place with pinned hashes; source and derived expression redistribution remains disabled under PMC and AACR terms.

samples.sample_role: Pretreatment primary or metastatic advanced ccRCC FFPE tumor used for bulk RNA sequencing

expression.label: Source-provided RSEM TPM
expression.mapping_source: Gene descriptions supplied with Ensembl identifiers in HCRN GU16-260 Supplementary Table S2
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Twenty-nine date-formatted descriptions are excluded because their original labels cannot be recovered unambiguously. All 2,140 rows carrying one of 203 case-insensitively duplicated descriptions are also excluded rather than aggregated. The remaining 54,069 supplied labels are exact and case-insensitively unique.
expression.scale_note: The authors' RSEM TPM matrix is preserved unchanged after exclusion of unrecoverable date-formatted and ambiguous duplicate descriptions. Values are intended only for within-cohort analysis.

endpoints.label: Overall survival during nivolumab therapy
endpoints.event_definition: Death from any cause during trial follow-up

endpoints.label: Progression-free survival during nivolumab therapy
endpoints.event_definition: Progression or death during trial follow-up
